Frequently asked questions

Common questions about appeal a state disability denial

What is State Disability Insurance (SDI)?

SDI provides short-term wage replacement for eligible workers who are unable to work due to a non-work-related illness or injury. It is administered by the state (e.g., California EDD).

How do I appeal a state disability denial?

File an appeal with your state's disability insurance agency within the deadline. The process varies by state — check your denial letter for specific instructions.
